Solve the following multiple-choice mathematics problem. You may reason before answering. End your final response with exactly "ANSWER: X", where X is one of A, B, C, D, E. Select one option.

today is thursday . i came home from a trip 3 days before the day after last monday . how many days have i been home ?

A. 1 day
B. 2 days
C. 7 days
D. 6 days
E. 10 days

message.content:
Coming home 3 days before the day after last Monday: Tuesday minus 3 days = Saturday. From Saturday to today (Thursday) is 6 days.

ANSWER: D
message.reasoning_content: Day after last Monday = Tuesday; 3 days before = Saturday. Thursday − Saturday: Saturday, Sun, Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu = 6 days? From Saturday to Thursday is 6 days. Answer D.

final_content:
Coming home 3 days before the day after last Monday: Tuesday minus 3 days = Saturday. From Saturday to today (Thursday) is 6 days.

ANSWER: D
